situation: Default uv environment excludes torch so make check can run without a CUDA wheel.
problem: test_run_progress_bar imported LightningTrainingRun before the ImportError skip, so pytest collection failed with ModuleNotFoundError: No module named torch.
successful_approach: Moved the lightning.run import inside the existing try/except ImportError guard, matching sibling lightning tests.
evidence: make check exited 0. pytest --cov reported 365 passed and 9 skipped.
reusable_lesson: When torch is an optional extra, keep torch imports inside the module-level skip guard. A skip after a top-level import never runs.
avoid: Importing torch-backed modules at test module top level before pytest.skip.
applicability: Pytest modules that must collect in an environment without torch.
